notes: Future release-binary mode must use an external profile data root.
Current tests validate manifests and planned commands only.

fixtures.title: TypeScript first-slice function-local micro nodes
fixtures.description: Locks the first MVP4.1 slice to TypeScript function-local node existence only.

fixtures.title: Return value local flow
fixtures.description: Return value flow is claimable only for the bounded local assignment and return steps.

fixtures.title: Argument to direct call flow
fixtures.description: A local argument flow proves only source-visible argument placement, not callee behavior.

initial_source.expected_parser_state: direct call and argument spans required

fixtures.title: Property access flow
fixtures.description: Property access can prove source-visible access mechanics without proving runtime object shape.

fixtures.title: Mutation method site
fixtures.description: A mutating method call is a local mutation site only, not a runtime state proof.

fixtures.title: Branch guard local path
fixtures.description: A branch guard proves only local guarded steps and unknown omitted branches.

fixtures.title: Sanitizer on actual local path
fixtures.description: A sanitizer call on the represented local path does not prove sanitizer correctness or security.

fixtures.title: Literal route handler structure
fixtures.description: Literal route structure is source evidence only until framework-aware route proof edges are implemented.

initial_source.expected_parser_state: literal route and handler spans required

fixtures.title: Auth role direct local call
fixtures.description: A direct auth role call proves source-visible local mechanics only, not authorization correctness.

initial_source.expected_parser_state: auth literal direct call spans required

fixtures.title: Async direct callback
fixtures.description: Direct callback registration records source-visible handler linkage, not event-loop behavior.

fixtures.title: Test assertion flow
fixtures.description: Test assertion evidence remains test source-role evidence and must not become production proof.

initial_source.expected_parser_state: test role and assertion spans required

fixtures.title: Multiple local returns
fixtures.description: Multiple returns require separate return sites and no collapsed packet identity.

fixtures.title: Early return local path
fixtures.description: Early return packets must preserve the early-exit path and omit global behavior claims.

fixtures.title: Destructuring boundary
fixtures.description: Destructuring must have an explicit slot identity contract before exact support.

initial_source.expected_parser_state: destructuring spans visible but exact slot contract future

fixtures.title: Alias assignment chain
fixtures.description: Alias assignment is a local derived path requiring provenance for every step.

fixtures.title: Closure capture boundary
fixtures.description: Closure capture is not first-slice exact and needs a resolver-backed capture contract.

fixtures.title: Same-name local shadowing
fixtures.description: Shadowed locals must preserve distinct scope identities.

fixtures.title: Nested scope paths
fixtures.description: Nested scopes must preserve function and block identity, not collapse same-name constructs.

fixtures.title: Partial broken-code recovery boundary
fixtures.description: Recovered syntax may be listed, but claimable micro-flow proof is forbidden until parser state is clean.

fixtures.title: Comment-only security proof forbidden
fixtures.description: A comment cannot prove auth, sanitizer, route, or security behavior.

files.contents:
// admin only
export function route() { return data(); }

negative_oracles.description: Comment text is documentation/text evidence only.
negative_oracles.why_not_proof: No source-spanned executable relation or resolver-backed proof exists.

fixtures.title: String proximity sanitizer proof forbidden
fixtures.description: A nearby sanitizer name cannot prove data passed through it.

files.contents:
const sanitizerName = 'sanitize';
export function save(input: string) { return persist(input); }

negative_oracles.forbidden_claim: nearby sanitizer string proves sanitized flow
negative_oracles.why_not_proof: No local edge connects input through a sanitizer call.

fixtures.title: Name match alone is not binding proof
fixtures.description: Same text names do not prove binding identity across scopes.

files.contents:
function target() {}
export function caller(target: () => void) { target(); }

negative_oracles.description: Lexical name match can shadow or collide.

fixtures.title: Computed import is not exact
fixtures.description: Computed import/require paths remain dynamic until resolved separately.

files.contents: export async function load(name) { return import('./plugins/' + name); }

negative_oracles.description: Computed import target cannot be proven from syntax alone.

fixtures.title: Reflection is not exact
fixtures.description: Reflection target and effects require runtime/compiler evidence.

files.contents: class Reflect { Object make(String name) throws Exception { return Class.forName(name).newInstance(); } }

negative_oracles.forbidden_claim: reflection target exact from source text
negative_oracles.why_not_proof: Runtime class name and classpath are required.

fixtures.title: Dynamic dependency injection is not exact
fixtures.description: DI container lookups cannot become binding proof from name or convention alone.

files.contents: export function run(container: Container) { return container.get('repo').save(); }

negative_oracles.why_not_proof: Container configuration and runtime state are not source graph proof.

fixtures.title: Macro hidden call not exact without expansion
fixtures.description: Macro-generated calls remain unsupported unless expansion is captured as proof input.

files.contents:
macro_rules! call_hidden { () => { hidden() } }
fn caller() { call_hidden!(); }

negative_oracles.why_not_proof: Expansion provenance is required before generated calls can be proof.

fixtures.title: Inactive C/C++ preprocessor branch not exact
fixtures.description: Inactive preprocessor code cannot emit exact source facts without preprocessing context.

negative_oracles.description: Inactive branch is not compiled source.
negative_oracles.why_not_proof: Preprocessor state and compile configuration are required.

fixtures.title: Computed callback is not exact
fixtures.description: Computed callback selection cannot be exact without runtime/resolver proof.

files.contents: export function wire(events: any, name: string, handlers: any) { events.on(name, handlers[name]); }

negative_oracles.why_not_proof: Runtime key value determines callback target.

fixtures.title: Unindexed cross-language target unknown
fixtures.description: Cross-language names do not prove bridge edges when the target side is unindexed.

files.contents: export function callPy() { return pyBridge.call('worker.run'); }

negative_oracles.description: The target language side is absent.
negative_oracles.forbidden_claim: cross-language bridge exact with unindexed side
negative_oracles.why_not_proof: Bridge proof requires both indexed sides or an explicit adapter proof.

fixtures.title: Full-source-body storage forbidden
fixtures.description: Micro-flow sidecars must not persist full source bodies or redundant snippets.

files.contents: export function tiny() { return 1; }

negative_oracles.description: Source bodies belong in source files, not sparse sidecars.
negative_oracles.why_not_proof: Storage contract permits spans and compact payloads only.

fixtures.title: Unbounded micro-node growth forbidden
fixtures.description: Extractor policy cannot bypass row caps or emit unbounded nodes.

files.contents: export function many(xs: string[]) { return xs.map(x => x.trim()); }

negative_oracles.description: Row count must be bounded by source constructs and caps.
negative_oracles.why_not_proof: Storage budget contract controls emission and retrieval.

fixtures.title: Duplicate micro-facts forbidden
fixtures.description: Repeat indexing cannot duplicate identical micro facts.

files.contents: export function once() { const value = 1; return value; }

negative_oracles.description: Stable IDs must upsert rather than duplicate.
negative_oracles.why_not_proof: Identity/provenance contract requires idempotent fact identity.

fixtures.title: Stale micro-flow reuse forbidden
fixtures.description: Changed source invalidates affected packets before reuse.

files.contents: export function stale(x: number) { const y = x + 1; return y; }

negative_oracles.description: Old packet cannot remain claimable after changed source.
negative_oracles.forbidden_claim: stale packet reused as fresh flow proof
negative_oracles.why_not_proof: Lifecycle binding and source invalidation are required.

fixtures.title: Candidate/vector match is not flow proof
fixtures.description: Candidate or vector retrieval can suggest a packet handle, but cannot prove flow.

files.contents: export function maybe(input: string) { return input; }

negative_oracles.description: Retrieval result is a candidate, not source proof.
negative_oracles.why_not_proof: Only deterministic micro-node/edge extraction with spans and provenance can prove flow.
